trip.title: One Zurich trip covers most of it
trip.text: Suitsupply, Nüschelerstrasse 26: blazer, trousers, merino crews, loafers. Book a fitting so they can pin the blazer and hem the trousers. Arket on the same trip: tees, wine crew, roll-neck, scarf. There's no Uniqlo in Switzerland and it doesn't ship here directly, so save Uniqlo top-ups for trips to Milan or Germany.

caution.name: Black
caution.why: Heavy near your face; deepens under-eye shadows.
caution.fix: Keep for trousers, shoes, outerwear. Show a white tee at the neckline or add a grey scarf.

caution.name: Camel
caution.fix: Always with navy, charcoal or grey at the neck.

caution.name: Cobalt / royal blue
caution.why: Makes your eyes pop but sharpens cheek redness.
caution.fix: Fine in small patterns or on casual days. Replace solids with cornflower.

caution.name: Tomato red
caution.why: Your least flattering drape. Redness takes over your face.
caution.fix: Wear wine or muted raspberry instead.

caution.name: Orange
caution.why: Like the Helly Hansen fleece: very visible redness.
caution.fix: Choose navy, spruce or slate for outdoor layers.

caution.name: Rose & watermelon pink
caution.why: Merges with your flush and reads blotchy.
caution.fix: Shell pink, or keep the warm pinks under a navy layer.

caution.name: Olive & khaki
caution.fix: Stone for trousers, sage or spruce for tops.

caution.name: Mustard & rust
caution.fix: For a rich autumn colour, choose wine or dusty teal instead.

rules: Cool greens and blues near your face make your skin look even. Warm reds, corals and oranges make the flush on your nose and cheeks stronger.
Charcoal with sky blue beats black with white. Pair a dark with a mid or light tone, not with its exact opposite.
Tonal greys or navies, then one note of sage, teal, lilac or wine. That's your monochrome-with-a-pop look.
Camel, black and saturated blues work best with a grey, navy or white layer between them and your face.
Merino, flannel, oxford cloth and heathered cotton suit soft colouring better than glossy or high-sheen fabrics.
Silver, steel, white gold and gunmetal. Straps in steel, grey, navy or dark brown-grey leather.
